resources.string: Missing payment notifications? Close and reopen VibeFinance first. If logging still does not work, open Notification access, switch VibeFinance off and back on, then return here. Check that automatic logging is enabled and your payment apps are selected.
Notification access settings are unavailable on this device.
When Power Saving mode is turned on, the system or OEM optimization may delay push alerts or suspend background services. We recommend setting VibeFinance to Unrestricted battery usage.
Unrestricted Battery: Prevents the system from suspending VibeFinance notification reader when battery saver is active.
Bank App Background Data: Ensure bank & payment apps are allowed background data so transaction alerts arrive promptly.
Extreme Power Saving: Maximum power saving modes (e.g. Samsung Limit apps) will suspend all 3rd-party background listeners.
Battery settings are unavailable on this device.
